newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day peso rallies, ends above resistance.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day peso rallies, ends above resistance.

text.p: The same-day peso closed firmer to penetrate a psychological resistance at 7.50 per dollar, due to dollars flowing into Mexico following an early fall in U.S. long bond rates, traders said.

"The peso looks very strong...I think there were people with long (dollar) positions, who stepped in to dump them before the peso gained more strength from the inflow of dollars," a currency trader said.

The same-day peso closed 3.3 centavos firmer at 7.4870/7.4920 per dollar. The benchmark 48-hour contract was 3.4 centavos firmer at 7.5100/7.5130, and the 24-hour contract 2.35 centavos firmer at 7.5050/7.5090.
Lower-than-expected inflation figures in the U.S. brought 30-year Treasury bond yields down to 6.96 percent.
"The U.S. economy had been expected to show signs of faster growth," a trader said.
